subject: Dedicated capacity pricing fit & throughput confirmation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing fit & throughput confirmation

Hi Emma —

Great to meet you and the BrightHealth infra team earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can size the dedicated lane and put together a clean pilot SOW: 

1) Volume assumptions
- Your call: you said ~120M tokens / month as a working number (including both prompts + generations). Can you confirm if that’s peak-month or steady-state?
- What’s the expected average response length (tokens) and peak-concurrency window (e.g., 10 minute peak factor)?

2) Latency & throughput targets
- You mentioned <250ms p50 end-to-end for typical requests and willing to accept up to 400ms p95. Confirm?
- If we assume a 10x peak factor, rough peak token throughput ~ 500 tokens/sec. Is that aligned with what you expect?

3) GPU preference and redundancy
- We typically recommend H100 lanes for latency-sensitive, high-throughput inference. A100 is still a cost-effective option for steady workloads. Any constraints on GPU family (vendor procurement, on-prem compatibility)?

4) Budget & unit economics
- You indicated a monthly budget range on the call. Can you share a $/month figure or target $/1M tokens you’d like to land on? That will determine whether we propose a 2xH100 reserved lane vs mixed H100/A100 or autoscaling on burst.

5) Next steps
- If you confirm volume and budget range, we’ll produce: (a) a throughput-to-GPU mapping (throughput_matrix.xlsx) with three sizing options (pilot, baseline, scale), and (b) a draft 3-month pilot SOW and pricing anchor.

I attached the initial throughput matrix template we’ll fill — if you can reply with the confirmed numbers by EOD tomorrow I’ll circulate the options and cost anchors.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0176
[Attachment: throughput_matrix.xlsx]

From: Emma Chen <emma@brighthealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightHealth Procurement <procurement@brighthealth.com>, BrightHealth Infra <infra@brighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing fit & throughput confirmation

Thanks Aditya — good summary. Quick answers below and a couple follow-ups from our side: 

- Volume: 120M tokens / month is our expected steady-state for the product we demoed (customer-facing conversational workflows). We do expect 20–30% month-over-month growth, but pilot should assume 120M.
- Average response length: ~150 tokens per interaction (prompt + generation combined average). Peak factor: we saw up to a 6x spike in prior campaigns; safe to plan for 8x peak for sizing.
- Latency: target is p50 < 200ms, p95 < 350ms — lower is better but p95 under 350ms is firm.
- GPU constraints: procurement prefers H100 for new capacity but will accept mixed A100 for cost reasons if the unit economics meet our target.
- Budget: procurement asked for indicative numbers. Target internal unit goal is $9–10 per 1M tokens (net of cloud infra costs we cover internally). Final monthly budget band for Redwood spend is $40k–$55k during pilot.

Can you size lanes for: (A) strict latency (H100-only) to hit p95 <350ms at 8x peak, (B) cost-first mixed lane that stays within $9–10/1M tokens, and (C) a stretch scale option for growth to 250M tokens/month? Also send the SOC2 evidence pack and sample SOW.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Product Operations | BrightHealth
emma@brighthealth.com
[Attachment: SOC2-request-list.txt]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing fit & throughput confirmation

Thanks — super helpful. Based on your numbers (120M/mo, 150 tokens/interaction, 8x peak, latency targets) here are three concrete sizing options we’ll populate in the attached matrix: 

Option 1 — Latency-first (H100-only)- Reserved: 2 x H100 (dedicated lane)- Expected sustained throughput: ~600 tokens/sec; 8x peak headroom to ~4,800 tokens/sec for short bursts using burst OOM and internal queueing policies- Typical p50/p95: ~110ms / ~300ms for 150-token generations on optimized kernels- Estimated price anchor: ~$9.8 per 1M tokens (pilot discount applied)

Option 2 — Cost-first (mixed family)- Reserved: 1 x H100 + 2 x A100 (mixed lane)- Sustained throughput: ~450 tokens/sec with p95 ~360ms under 8x peak (some tail risk on p95 for longest sequences)- Estimated price anchor: ~$8.6 per 1M tokens

Option 3 — Scale path (for growth to 250M/mo)- Reserved: 4 x H100 (modular lanes or multiple reserved units)- Sustained throughput: ~2,000 tokens/sec; p95 comfortably <350ms- Estimated blended price anchor: ~$7.9 per 1M tokens (volume commit required to reach this anchor)

Notes and assumptions (short):
- Token accounting: we bill by tokens generated + prompt tokens. We used your 150-token average.
- Sizing math: the matrix assumes convolutional caching and continuous batching; actual throughput depends on model family and sequence-length distribution.
- Burst behavior: short bursts above reserved capacity are served by our burst pool and will incur incremental per-token burst pricing. We can add a burst credit line during pilot to smooth costs.

I’ve attached the throughput_matrix.xlsx (filled with the three options) and a short SOC2 pack pointer. Lauren, looping you for final commercial anchors and to attach the sample SOW. Emma — if these anchors land in your $40–$55k pilot band, we can propose a 3-month pilot starting with Option 1 or 2 and convert to Option 3 as you scale.

— Aditya
[Attachment: throughput_matrix.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@brighthealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing fit & throughput confirmation

Emma — looping in the commercial details and next steps. Thanks for the clarity.

Attached: BrightHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (3-month pilot SOW), throughput_matrix.xlsx (detailed numbers), SOC2-evidence-request.docx (answers & links)

Commercial proposal (high level):
- Pilot term: 3 months, prepaid month-by-month with 30-day termination right during pilot.
- Proposed pilot lanes: start with Option 2 (1xH100 + 2xA100) to balance cost and latency. If strict latency proves required we’ll convert to Option 1 during month 2.
- Pricing anchor: $9.0 per 1M tokens (applies to pilot usage up to 150M tokens / month). Overages billed at $10.8 per 1M tokens.
- One-time onboarding fee: $7,500 (includes performance tuning, KV cache warm-up, and placeholder SRE hours).
- SOC2 pack: link in attached doc.

Next steps:
1) Emma / Procurement to confirm pilot start date and preferred lane (Option 1 vs Option 2)
2) Sign SOW and NDA (DocuSign link in SOW PDF)
3) Shared kick-off with infra + SRE for posture review and scheduling (target onboarding window: 10 business days from signed SOW)

If procurement confirms the $40k–$55k pilot band, we’ll issue the DocuSign and reserve the lanes. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk procurement through the SOW.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0224
